source: ANSI S3.5-1997 Table 3 standard speech spectrum level, normal vocal effort (as reproduced in github.com/google/speech_intelligibility_index, speech_intelligibility_index/sii.py)
displayName: Universal LTASS (ANSI S3.5 standard speech spectrum)
notes: ANSI SII standard speech spectrum (normal effort), closely related to the LTASS; Byrne et al. 1994 (JASA 96:2108) table could not be verified from two independent reproductions, so it is not used. Spectrum levels (dB/Hz) converted to 1/3-octave band levels by adding 10*log10(bandwidth), IEC base-10 edges (fc*10^+-0.05), normalised to 1 kHz band = 0 dB. 160 Hz-8 kHz verified. 100 and 125 Hz are extrapolated (conservative LF rolloff, ~-4 dB/band); 10 kHz is extrapolated (-16.0, continuing the high-frequency flattening); bands below 100 Hz and above 10 kHz hold the 100 Hz / 10 kHz values (outside operating range). Source URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/speech_intelligibility_index/main/speech_intelligibility_index/sii.py
